title: nauclea xanthoxylon
intro: Nauclea xanthoxylon, commonly known as the Yellow Serpent Tree, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Nauclea xanthoxylon include its potential to treat fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antimalarial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Nauclea xanthoxylon include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
